name: Revenge Served Cold A Life Reclaimed
original_name: Revenge Served Cold A Life Reclaimed
overview: Saúl Leal, a wealthy young man, went to great lengths to win over Yanira Guzmán—the daughter of his family's chauffeur—after falling in love with her. However, Yanira set a trap for him that ultimately led to his death. After his resurrection, Saúl returns to his college days and exposes Yanira’s scheme; she had been pretending to be an aristocratic young lady. Determined not to be blinded by love again, Saúl leaves her to her own devices, ensuring she cannot succeed without his support.
